description: One row of variants.jsonl. One variant across every paper that reports it, with counts as a range rather than a merge.

coding_keys.description: Every coding-DNA change in the group; several mean different nucleotide changes with the same protein consequence
coding_keys.title: Coding Keys

grch38.description: GRCh38 positions of the coding changes, as Ensembl VEP places them
grch38.title: Grch38

grouped_by.description: protein or coding: which key the records were grouped on
grouped_by.title: Grouped By

n_papers.description: Papers reporting the variant, reviews included
n_papers.title: N Papers

n_primary_papers.description: Papers reporting the variant that are not reviews
n_primary_papers.title: N Primary Papers

normalization_flags.description: Normalization flags raised on any record in the group
normalization_flags.title: Normalization Flags

papers_de_novo_assumed.description: Papers calling at least one case de novo without parental testing described
papers_de_novo_assumed.title: Papers De Novo Assumed

papers_de_novo_confirmed.description: Papers reporting at least one de novo case with both parents tested
papers_de_novo_confirmed.title: Papers De Novo Confirmed

papers_functional.description: Papers describing functional work on the variant
papers_functional.title: Papers Functional

papers_inherited.description: Papers reporting at least one case inherited from a parent
papers_inherited.title: Papers Inherited

phenotype_systems.description: Organ systems affected in at least one carrier in any paper, comma-separated
phenotype_systems.title: Phenotype Systems

pointer_pmids.description: Reviews in the group: pointers to the literature, never counts
pointer_pmids.title: Pointer Pmids

probands_max.description: Most distinct probands in clinical reports: every paper independent, except records a paper says were reported before
probands_max.title: Probands Max

probands_min.description: Fewest distinct probands in clinical reports: the largest single paper's count, as if every other report re-described its patients
probands_min.title: Probands Min

records_prior_report.description: Records whose paper says the family was reported before
records_prior_report.title: Records Prior Report

screened_carriers.description: Carriers found by screening at least 1,000 people (cohorts and biobanks), counted apart from clinical probands
screened_carriers.title: Screened Carriers

variant_id.description: The grouping key: protein HGVS on the reference protein, or coding-DNA HGVS on the reference transcript when there is no protein change
variant_id.title: Variant Id

title: VariantRow
